flavor: A highly affordable snack that holds the same status as fried rice in reality. It is enjoyed by both the poor and the wealthy for its intensely sour flavor.\n\n"Caution: Its excessive acidity may awake you from your dream."

materials.name: Quantum Ripples
materials.flavor: Ripples in the Sea of Quanta. Although called "ripples," they are in fact the most basic form of energy fluctuation. "Time, there's so much time." "All the time there is."

materials.name: Tranquility
materials.flavor: After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.\n\n"Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

name: "Dreamlight" Mixed Sweets
effect: Upon use, all allies may consume or restore Energy or HP at the beginning of each turn for the next battle.
flavor: A specialty candy of Penacony, each piece concealing a unique filling. Some compare it to life, as you will never know its taste until you try it yourself.\n\n"This one is spicy!"

materials.name: Hunger
materials.flavor: In Penacony, "hunger" is an expensive spice that can make any food in the Dreamscape irresistible. In the world beyond dreams, "hunger" is the smile on the lips of death. "They say hunger is the best seasoning, but I just want to fill my stomach."

materials.name: Vortex of Wind
materials.flavor: The eye of the storm remains stagnant. Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm. "Look, they won't stop no matter what happens. They just keep whirling. You know what that reminds me of?" "Trailblazing!" "...That's right, Pom-Pom. Promise me that our trailblazing journey will never come to a stop."

name: Momentary Freedom
effect: Upon use, increases all allies' Max HP by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> plus <unbreak>100</unbreak> Max HP for the next battle.
flavor: As the airship traverses the sky, leaving behind a trail of clouds, the IPC's pursuers disappear from sight. You exchange a high-five with your companions, feeling liberated from any constraints... However, this is not the end. The looming threat of prison remains. It may be ten years or a hundred, but eventually, you will return to it. "Until then, let's savor our freedom to the fullest."

materials.name: Old Molar
materials.flavor: No one knows the origin of this molar. The person selling it claims this extremely anachronistic item was found on the battlefield of the Emperor's War, infused by a bygone era of craftsmanship and defiance now lost in modern times.\n\n"It serves as the growth rings of inorganic life."

materials.name: Rusty Gear
materials.flavor: Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities.\n\n"The best gear is always the one that fits perfectly."

name: Sword in the Stone
effect: When used, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>190</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: There's a legend in Little Gui's homeworld: Whoever pulls out the sword in the stone would be the great hero foretold in prophecies. However, no one ever managed to pull it out, and few even tried — because that was a historical relic. You'd get jailed for damaging it. "I regret it so much right now... I was just feeling impulsive at that moment and wanted to show off to my friends. That's why I went to pull out the sword. I hope everyone can learn from my mistake..."

materials.name: Flying Sword Model
materials.effect: When used, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>100</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: This travel souvenir sold aboard the Skysplitter, based on Yanqing's flying sword, is quite popular among tourists. Despite being a toy sword, its quality is immaculate, even serving as a suitable training prop for beginners. Yanqing once intentionally used it to beat several challengers who lacked martial virtue to the point of crying for their parents. "Although your defeat this time is regretful, there's no need to be discouraged. If you're willing to challenge again, I'll be ready to accept anytime." "Anytime? Then make sure you sleep with an eye open."

materials.name: Meteoric Alloy
materials.flavor: Resilient meteoric ironsand. Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders. "Let's grab as much as we can. Qlipoth will need them." "I have no idea whether the Aeon need them or not. All I know is that the IPC will pay big bucks for them."

name: Interstellar Braised Beast
effect: Upon use, there is a high chance to immediately heal a single ally by <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of their Max HP, and a small chance of immediately consuming HP equal to <unbreak>99%</unbreak> of their Max HP from a single ally.
flavor: The fitness meal developed by Juhuan, the "Brawn Author." It is made from intensely boiling meat from different interstellar beasts. It is extremely nutritious but extremely foul in taste — However, given how Juhuan craves to become a god, the pain he must endure while eating is a part of his trials too. By the way, he's already writing the mantra that he will distribute to his disciples once he ascends to godhood. It's temporarily named The Compendium of Juhuan's Brawn Doctrines. "I have witnessed the Grandmaster Juhuan in the gym speaking with 250 great brawny warriors: 'Barbell back squat! Lateral raises with dumbbells! Strong biceps can stop a crying child! Good lats can make you divine incarnate! Gimme ten sets! Gimme all you've got! You look the best when you're trying hard!'"

materials.name: Crystal Lizard Satay
materials.effect: Upon use, immediately recovers 4 Technique Points for your team, but each team member loses HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
materials.flavor: A skewer made from cold-blooded reptiles that live in mines. Zoologists will tell you that the crystals on the lizard's body are actually a by-product of its body's osmoregulation and the maintenance of body fluid levels. They'll also tell you that this by-product should never be eaten. "It tastes like chicken, and it's crunchy!"

materials.name: Tian Dong
materials.flavor: While plants of the Tian Dong genus typically grow on land, Tian Dong plants of Scalegorge Waterscape stand out by extensively inhabiting the coastal areas of the Lunarescent Depths. Although artificial cultivation techniques for Tian Dong have become quite prevalent, there are still many who believe in the superstition that "wild plants have stronger medicinal properties," causing significant trouble for the Pearlkeepers.\n\n"Plunderers of Tian Dong, to the Shackling Prison they will go."

name: Golden Honeycake
effect: When entering the next battle, all allies immediately heal for <unbreak>24%</unbreak> of their respective Max HP.
flavor: Golden Honeycakes, one of the oldest delicacies in Amphoreus history, was once a favorite high-end dessert among the nobility. Now, it's becoming a trendy, fashionable food on Okhema's teleslate... "This thing blew up way too fast... I'm a native Okheman, but I never had sweet pancakes at home growing up!" "Apparently, a dessert shop got Mr. Mydei to advertise it on the teleslate, and after it went viral, other businesses got envious..." "...But honestly, you have to admit, the new flavors they've developed are actually pretty good."

materials.name: Deep Marrow Rock Salt
materials.flavor: Salt crystals unearthed from the depths of the rift valley, revered by the farmers who toil on the land. Many keep one of these crystals in their homes, treasuring it as the "bared spine marrow of Georios," a generous gift to the farmers. When reclaiming barren land, just a small sprinkling of this rock salt is enough to transform the barren soil into fertile ground, breathing life back into the earth. \n\n"Non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic fertilizer is the best!"

materials.name: Basic Ingredients
materials.flavor: Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

name: Rough-Brew Ambrosia
effect: Upon use, increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: The ambrosia made through an incredibly simple ritual process has a rough taste, but due to its very low price, it still has a considerable market. It is said that during the fight against the black tide, when clean water was scarce, people relied on this rough-brew ambrosia to supplement their hydration and nutrients.\n\n"Okhema now has clean water, o sire of my children. Stop making excuses to buy ambrosia every day."

materials.name: Bough of Thought
materials.flavor: A glowing bough with branches sprawling unrestrained in every direction, resembling the organic divergence of thought. It is born in a quiet corner of the Grove where scholars often drift into contemplative dazes. Though lacking any practical use, Cerces appears particularly fond of such curiosities. Legend has it that the Titan would select the bough with the most intricate branching and wear it atop their head as an ornament. \n\n"For a long time, I've been going to bed early, yet it does little to quiet my restless mind. It feels as though the thoughts from a past life have been reborn within me... At some point, I began to notice a cluster of intertwined branches outside my window."

materials.name: Distinctive Tattered Feather
materials.flavor: A feather adorned with the Titan Aquila's symbol, often found on cliff faces near the heavens. Some believe these are ciliary feathers shed by Aquila, the hundred-eyed giant bird, while others think they are remnants of birds of prey that soared too high, caught in Aquila's gaze, and met their demise. In ancient times, Aquila's disciples collected these feathers in bulk, using them to craft the ceremonial priestly miter. Notably, the Titan symbol on the feathers fades if left exposed to the night air for too long. "If my love for you could be measured... it would surpass the number of Aquila's eyelashes!" "...Though, now that I think about it, does the hundred-eyed giant bird even have eyelashes?"

name: Dried Sagelore Fruit
effect: Upon use, immediately recovers 3 Technique Points for the team.
flavor: Grove Scholars can weave knowledge into the sacred tree, and with Cerces' permission, they may harvest its fruit that houses condensed wisdom. Each of these Titan-blessed seeds holds information weightier than a library. But even so, like any other information vessel, the seeds have a limited shelf life as carriers of knowledge. Fortunately, their shelf life as food far outlasts that as a knowledge vessel — thus, this delicious dried fruit was born. "Wait... if I could get a fresh one to eat, would I become the smartest person in Okhema overnight?" "Someone tried that once, and they went mad. You can't pour a whole lake into a water bowl."

materials.flavor: Reproductive units unique to plants. Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good. "Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

name: Northern Helm
effect: Upon use, all allies gain <unbreak>18%</unbreak> increased Shield Effect for the next battle.
flavor: Once belonged to a soldier of Aidonia, this helmet is crafted from the tanned mane of a direwolf. Its fearsome appearance alone is enough to sap the will of enemies who fear death. Warriors who wore this helmet crept onto the battlefield like wild grass, and vanished like morning dew. "The living shall one day join the dead. The bridge across the Styx knows no order." — Aidonia

flavor: Wheat was Aedes Elysiae's main produce. Bread made from it was sweet, soft, and incredibly delicious. materials.name: Protein Rice
materials.flavor: Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives. Smooth as egg white and full of protein. "Every grain costs sweat and blood."

name: Healing Spray
effect: Upon use, immediately heals a single ally by <unbreak>38%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>400</unbreak> extra HP.
flavor: A common medicine used by adventurers to quickly seal wounds with adhesive foam.\n\n"In the past, all medical breakthroughs were made with the sweat and blood of the pioneers in this field. Now, with the help of Healing Spray, only sweat is needed!"

materials.name: Solid Water
materials.flavor: Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

materials.name: Ambergris of Abundance
materials.flavor: Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance. Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip. Do not ask what it's made of. "It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."

name: Disposable Shield
effect: When used, increase DEF of all allies by <unbreak>15%</unbreak>, and Effect RES by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: When the Armed Archaeologists of Intelligentsia Guild was first established, its casualty rate reached an appalling 34.88%, for they were met with heavy resistance from the natives wherever they went because of their barbaric behavior. To change this, the Interastral Peace Corporation provided them with large quantities of basic protection gears that can fend off one fatal blow when hit. While the protection offered by these gears was limited, they did reduce the casualty rate by 9.72%, at least on paper. The IPC was very pleased to see that. "First thing first my scholars, always turn your shields on. Second, remember morons: They can block explosions only once! Don't ever forget that!"

materials.name: Mechanical Parts
materials.flavor: Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions. Without them, nothing can be made. "With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day." "Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

materials.name: Preservation Construction Material
materials.flavor: Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation. When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard. Please do not use together with Solid Water. "I regret to say that Intelligentsia Guild's research on the material used to build the Subspace Crystalline Barrier by Amber Lord still needs time to reveal its nature." "I'm sure it's not cement — am I right, Taravan?"

materials.name: Hard Chip of Nihility
materials.flavor: A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility. It may have been a coin that people use to buy things. But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them. "I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

name: Energy Drink (sugar-free)
effect: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
flavor: A bottle of Energy Drink. Some may call it soulless, but honestly, it's not that bad.\n\n"Being slim is more about tricking the eye. It doesn't necessarily have to do with my weight."

materials.name: Phlogiston
materials.flavor: Particles that form the flame. Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it. #7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence. "Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

materials.name: Virtual Particle
materials.flavor: Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory. Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality. "I've got a virtual particle and an anti virtual particle here. How do we turn them into a real particle and a real antiparticle? Now, look closely..."

materials.name: Tree Bark of Erudition
materials.flavor: Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition. Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature. It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking. "The wisdom of mankind is contained in this one word."

name: Antimatter Field Generator
effect: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>260</unbreak> and CRIT Rate by 8% for the next battle.
flavor: Despite being blessed by Nanook the Aeon and having the know-how of making a multitude of heavy weaponry, some members of the Antimatter Legion still prefer primitive non-firearms. The Voidrangers implant Antimatter Field Generators into their arms to form formidable Field Blades.\n\n"Like a hot knife through butter."

materials.name: Strange Matter of Destruction
materials.flavor: Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction. Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds. Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash. "Creatures that received blessing from Nanook all have twisted appearances."

name: High-Tech Protective Gear
effect: Upon use, increases DEF of all allies by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> and enhances the max DMG that can be absorbed by Shields cast on allies by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> in the next battle.
flavor: High-Tech protective gear developed by the Intelligentsia Guild. It keeps the most vulnerable parts of your body from harm and converts the impact into energy used to charge the gear, making it fit for prolonged combat operations. The prototypes of this model were distributed in small numbers among the Armed Archaeologists, allowing the Guild to collect large amounts of data to help improve the model. The Interastral Peace Corporation was tasked to sell it on the retail market. "When can we get our hands on the upgraded model?" "Soon, my scholars...! You're gonna have to make do with Disposable Shields for the time being."

"That's impossible. I, Sampo, do not sell counterfeits. I'm a reputable businessman after all!"

materials.effect: Upon use, immediately causes a single ally to lose HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.

materials.flavor: Warm dark feather with a weak ember at its tip. Sparks trail the feather as it's waved around. "The legend of the Phoenix spreads far throughout the entire universe..."

materials.name: Strange Matter of Destruction
materials.flavor: Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction. Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds. Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash. "Creatures that received blessing from Nanook all have twisted appearances."

name: Enhancement Paste: Ice
effect: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

materials.name: Solid Water
materials.flavor: Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

materials.name: Core of Ice
materials.flavor: Shattered ice fallen from the stars. The frosty mist it emits when removed from a specialized canister looks like the breath of wintertime. "Zoom in on a snowflake 100 times and behold the wonder of nature."

materials.name: Tree Bark of Erudition
materials.flavor: Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition. Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature. It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking. "The wisdom of mankind is contained in this one word."

name: Enhancement Paste: Lightning
effect: Upon use, increases Lightning DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

materials.name: Metal
materials.flavor: A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean. Very useful, very handy. "I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."

materials.name: Eye of Lightning
materials.flavor: An electric ball made from captured lightning. If its balance is tipped by a conductor, it emits a lightning ball. "A genius in the past wanted to use Eye of Lightning to search for aliens. For this, Nous cast their gaze upon her. Not sure which is the bigger win: Found aliens for real or got noticed by Nous?"

materials.name: Ambergris of Abundance
materials.flavor: Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance. Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip. Do not ask what it's made of. "It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."

name: Enhancement Paste: Quantum
effect: Upon use, increases Quantum DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

materials.name: Gaseous Liquid
materials.flavor: Is it fog, rain, or wind? You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid. "The answer my friend, is blowing in the gaseous liquid..." "The answer is blowing in the gaseous liquid."

materials.name: Quantum Ripples
materials.flavor: Ripples in the Sea of Quanta. Although called "ripples," they are in fact the most basic form of energy fluctuation. "Time, there's so much time." "All the time there is."

materials.name: Slime of Harmony
materials.flavor: A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony. It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination. A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go. "All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"

name: Enhancement Paste: Imaginary
effect: Upon use, increases Imaginary DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

materials.name: Seed
materials.flavor: Reproductive units unique to plants. Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good. "Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

materials.name: Leaf of Imaginary
materials.flavor: A leaf of unknown origin. It doesn't belong to any plant and is more of a representation of something more abstract. The ancient light nourishes the leaf through its veins, displaying its faded but remnant power. "One leaf, one world."

materials.name: Hard Chip of Nihility
materials.flavor: A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility. It may have been a coin that people use to buy things. But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them. "I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

name: Vomit Inducing Agent
effect: Upon use, immediately causes a target ally to lose HP equal to <unbreak>99%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
flavor: Don't bite off more than you can chew. But when you do, use some of this and let it work wonders. You become more resolute when holding it. "No one is born a loser. Always have faith in yourself."

materials.name: Trash
materials.effect: Upon use, immediately causes a single ally to lose HP equal to <unbreak>15%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
materials.flavor: Worthless trash. Better carry some with you. "Some say that in the deep retreats of the cosmos, an invisible portal will open to those carrying a piece of junk."

name: All Good Potion
effect: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of Max Energy for a single ally.
flavor: A surprise side product obtained during the Department of Implement Arts' experiments. Research has proven it to be harmless to humans. Most researchers indicate they "feel all good" after using this liquid, therefore giving this item the non-official name of "All Good Potion."\n\n"Note: Caution! Side effects from this liquid remains unknown!"

materials.name: Metal
materials.flavor: A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean. Very useful, very handy. "I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."

materials.name: Basic Ingredients
materials.flavor: Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

materials.name: Protein Rice
materials.flavor: Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives. Smooth as egg white and full of protein. "Every grain costs sweat and blood."

name: Snow Plains Combo Stew
effect: Upon use, decreases Fire DMG taken by all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> and increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: The iron bucket contains all sorts of Belobog delicacies as a stew, and is simmered thoroughly using low heat. Ingredients with outlandish appearances float in the soup, but it smells very delicious. "What's wrong if they were once specimens? Aren't they dead animals and plants anyways?"

materials.name: Frostweave Salmon Bread
materials.effect: Upon use, decreases Fire DMG taken by all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: A cold platter made from air-fried preserved frostweave salmon and bread, with a bowl of redsunset jam for free. Nowadays, frostweave salmon are mostly bred inside Belobog's walls. Their taste is miles off from the frostweave salmons fished from the wilds outside the city. "I heard having raw fish slices together with bread can delay the onset of diarrhea effectively. Is that true?" "Heck if I know. Go ask Natasha."

materials.name: Stone-Roasted Meat Skewer
materials.effect: Upon use, increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: The steel skewer has all sorts of Belobog delicacies on it, and is barbecued thoroughly using high heat. Its ingredients are mostly harmless. It is also the favorite food of Belobog's adventurers out in the wild, as well as being the most easily obtainable. "This tastes so good! What kinds of meat are in it, though?" "You wouldn't want to know."

materials.name: Solid Water
materials.flavor: Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

name: Prayer Machine
effect: Upon use, all allies and enemies will restore <unbreak>1000</unbreak> HP at the start of the turn for the next battle, lasting for 5 turns.
flavor: Items seized from the remnants of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. Once the switch is activated, it will automatically chant the "Thousand-Handed Merciful Medicus' Salvation."\n\n"I hereby plant the sacred tree to liberate those living beings: So that life is boundless and old age never coming; death revitalizes; all troubles are dispelled."

materials.name: Ambergris of Abundance
materials.flavor: Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance. Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip. Do not ask what it's made of. "It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."

materials.name: Jade Abacus Unit
materials.flavor: The most essential component of jade abaci, commonly used in the final step of installation.\n\n"Pick one, they are all outdated models. But once installed, they will undoubtedly bring a soul-like essence to your machines."

materials.name: Discarded Ingenium Parts
materials.flavor: To a bystander, it's just trash. To a craftsman, it's leftover materials. To a recycler, it's credits. Only skilled artisans who truly understand the art of ingenia can see valuable treasures in what others deem wasteful.\n\n"It is said that in the Great Trial of the Furnace, to challenge Mr. Yingxing, they gave him a pile of defective products and waste. But after a day and night, he crafted a lifelike mechanical lion that moved as if it was alive."

name: Five-Grain Jade Elixir
effect: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to 5% of their Max HP, and increases their Technique DMG by <unbreak>100%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: This beverage is rich and refreshing, with a uniquely wild and almost crude taste that impresses even connoisseurs outside of the Xianzhou. However, there is much debate among consumers about the exact combination of the "five grains."\n\nIn our Thalassa Crystal Palace distillery, the so-called "five grains" are Diatomaceous Earth, Saltwort, Verdant Velvet, Lithosalt Blossom, and Shipwreck Grass.

materials.name: Stone of The Hunt
materials.flavor: Small stone with the power of The Hunt. As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction. Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not. "The destination lies where my arrow is heading."

materials.name: Short Rejuvepill
materials.effect: Upon use, immediately heals one ally for 1 HP.
materials.flavor: A simple remedy made by grinding mountain devil mint, white-hair ivy extract, and droppings from blue-winged squirrels into powder, then kneading them with honey to form pills. It can't cure all ailments, but it is considered to be better than nothing.\n\n"Quick, take this medicine, or your wound will have healed on its own."

materials.name: Human-Height Auspicious Crops
materials.flavor: The robust and bountiful rice ears are astonishingly as tall as a person. In certain agricultural and pastoral delves of Xianzhou, such towering auspicious crops can be found everywhere.\n\n"The scholars who planted them hoped that people would never have to experience the feeling of hunger again."

name: Health Detox Pill
effect: Upon use, all allies are immune to debuffs for 3 turns for the next battle.
flavor: An all-purpose antidote that can neutralize the majority of toxic substances entering the human body. The manufacturer is obligated to include a warning on the packaging:\n\n"Do not consume poison just to test this pill's effectiveness!"

materials.name: Dragon Scale Coral
materials.flavor: At the bottom of Lunarescent Depths, there is a diverse array of nearly a hundred coral species, among which dragon scale coral holds the greatest value. Within the coral skeleton of dragon scale coral, there is a rich concentration of Heavenly East compound. This compound serves as the finest antibiotic in the cosmos and possesses numerous other medicinal properties. Despite almost ten thousand years of efforts, humans have yet to learn how to industrially produce this compound. In front of the entrance to the Fanghu's Alchemy Commission stands a statue of dragon scale coral. Underneath it, there is an inscription that reads: "When you mistakenly believe you can control nature, always remember: Nature is the ultimate biochemist."

materials.name: Tian Dong
materials.flavor: While plants of the Tian Dong genus typically grow on land, Tian Dong plants of Scalegorge Waterscape stand out by extensively inhabiting the coastal areas of the Lunarescent Depths. Although artificial cultivation techniques for Tian Dong have become quite prevalent, there are still many who believe in the superstition that "wild plants have stronger medicinal properties," causing significant trouble for the Pearlkeepers.\n\n"Plunderers of Tian Dong, to the Shackling Prison they will go."

materials.name: Extract of Medicinal Herbs
materials.flavor: Medicinal herbs are the foundation of Xianzhou's medical practice, and these extracts capture the active ingredients from various herbs, enhancing their medicinal efficacy in leaps and bounds.\n\n"The value of 'tradition' lies in its ability to evolve and progress, rather than remaining stagnant."

name: Jade Marrow Diffusion
effect: Upon use, increases Effect RES of all allies by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A poultice made by refining gentle halcyon horn and cryojade, then grinding them into powder and mixing them with a large amount of herbal extracts. It is greenish in color, has a pleasant fragrance, and has therapeutic effects in promoting the healing of muscle injuries, fractures, and bone fractures. Strictly prohibited for internal use! "The leg has already deteriorated severely and requires amputation." "Please, doctor, can't you prescribe something to save it?" "Even if I do, you won't follow the instructions."

materials.name: Tree Bark of Erudition
materials.flavor: Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition. Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature. It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking. "The wisdom of mankind is contained in this one word."

materials.name: Extract of Medicinal Herbs
materials.flavor: Medicinal herbs are the foundation of Xianzhou's medical practice, and these extracts capture the active ingredients from various herbs, enhancing their medicinal efficacy in leaps and bounds.\n\n"The value of 'tradition' lies in its ability to evolve and progress, rather than remaining stagnant."

materials.name: Grande Rejuvepill
materials.effect: Upon use, immediately heals one ally for <unbreak>10</unbreak> HP.
materials.flavor: A simple remedy made by grinding blue maple deer antler, sprout combination remedy, and droppings from blue-winged squirrels into powder, then kneading them with honey to form pills. It has some healing effects, but not significant. "Your medicine's effectiveness... is it any different from a bowl of brown sugar water?" "Of course it is. Brown sugar water is sweet, while my medicine is as spicy as drinking boiling water."

name: Pom-Pom's Fried Fowl
effect: Upon use, increases Fire DMG of all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> and ATK of all allies by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A signature delicacy from the "Astral Express" prepared by Conductor Pom-Pom themselves. First, the poultry (any species, preferably avian) is marinated and coated with Pom-Pom's special seasoning and breading. Then, with the heating and pressure of controlled high-energy particles, it is deep-fried precisely for a duration of 0.2434 seconds until golden brown. The result is a dish blessed with a tender exterior and a juicy interior. One bite and you'll feel as if you're being caressed by the gentle gaze of Akivili, soothed in comfort and warmth.\n\n"Voyage among stars for a taste of Cosmos!"

materials.name: Fruitwood-Grilled Shantak Moa Drumettes
materials.effect: Upon use, increases Fire DMG of all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: Cooked using the flesh of extraterrestrial monsters defeated by Yancui, the chef of Spices Supreme. Shantak moas are inherently ferocious creatures, and while some people use them as mounts to traverse the icy vacuum, the cost is sacrificing their own limbs as sustenance for the creatures.\n\n"Oh, the bird! It whipped its head around and it glared at me, wanting to peck me. But with a palm strike to its face, it fell limp, just like mud. It was only then did I realize that both it and I were suspended in midair..."

materials.flavor: Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

materials.name: Phlogiston
materials.flavor: Particles that form the flame. Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it. #7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence. "Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

name: Children's Fragrant Orange Pills
effect: Upon use, immediately heals one ally by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>320</unbreak>.
flavor: Orange-flavored pills to cure children's colds. They say that the first batch was so tasty that many boisterous children took too much of it. Hence, many Children's Fragrant Orange Pills on the market now contain a great deal of bitterness to their flavoring. "Wahhh, Mama, why does this pellet smell so sweet but taste so bitter..." "Because that's life, silly child."

name: Alfalfa Salad
effect: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT Rate by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A vegetable salad that was once sold at an astounding price, believed to bring good luck and happiness to those who consumed it. Later, a chef replaced the expensive clover with regular lettuce, making it an affordable dish for the masses.\n\n"But now, it no longer brings anyone happiness."

materials.name: The Sound and the Fury
materials.flavor: As you may have realized, the majority of sounds in this world are noise, and the majority of words are meaningless combinations. Don't let these distractions sway your judgment. "Life is like a fool's dream filled with the sound and the fury, but ultimately meaningless."

materials.name: Hunger
materials.flavor: In Penacony, "hunger" is an expensive spice that can make any food in the Dreamscape irresistible. In the world beyond dreams, "hunger" is the smile on the lips of death. "They say hunger is the best seasoning, but I just want to fill my stomach."

materials.name: Seed
materials.flavor: Reproductive units unique to plants. Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good. "Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

name: The Moment of Betrayal
effect: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by <unbreak>36%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: You will always remember the trust and gentleness of that person, the persuasion and incitement from those people, and the surprised whisper from that person the moment you drew your dagger.\n\n"Et tu, my child?"

materials.name: The Sound and the Fury
materials.flavor: As you may have realized, the majority of sounds in this world are noise, and the majority of words are meaningless combinations. Don't let these distractions sway your judgment. "Life is like a fool's dream filled with the sound and the fury, but ultimately meaningless."

materials.name: Confounding
materials.flavor: I've never been outstanding since I was a kid. I barely met the requirements to get into college, and I barely earned enough credits to obtain my degree. Now, I'm sitting at my desk, contemplating how to explain my understanding of "confusion" to you, but am I really worthy of showering you with my superficial understanding? And do you really need to listen to all this broken gibberish of mine? I don't know the answer.\n\n"Anyway, I hope you enjoy yourself."

materials.name: Broken Dreams
materials.flavor: Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony. They once belonged to broken hearts. "In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

name: Fleeting Happiness
effect: Upon use, immediately heals one ally by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>320</unbreak> HP.
flavor: The lengthy meeting reaches an intermission, and you step out to the atrium, finding solace on a bench and releasing a long breath. The sinking sun, accompanied by an evening breeze, brings the sweetness of nature, boldly combatting against the man-made stainless steel behemoth behind you. A stray cat stretches and jumps onto your lap.\n\n"At least, at this moment, I belong to myself."

materials.name: Thermal Gel
materials.flavor: Heat dissipation is a challenge that all Intellitrons must overcome. Although Intellitrons created using different generations of technology differ significantly in terms of materials and internal structures, traditional physical heat dissipation often remains the most suitable choice for many models.\n\n"It's just like organic beings bathing in water."

materials.name: Old Molar
materials.flavor: No one knows the origin of this molar. The person selling it claims this extremely anachronistic item was found on the battlefield of the Emperor's War, infused by a bygone era of craftsmanship and defiance now lost in modern times.\n\n"It serves as the growth rings of inorganic life."

materials.name: Tranquility
materials.flavor: After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.\n\n"Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

name: The Cloud of Doubt
effect: Upon use, all allies take <unbreak>15%</unbreak> less DMG for the next battle.
flavor: You sit up, a cloud of sadness forming in your mind. The words you have promised to others begin to falter. Are you really not a loser? Can you really achieve anything? Have you really chosen the right path? A fire ignites from the depths of your heart, and for one moment, you're tempted to burn everything from the past to the ground...\n\n"And that spark had already been ignited long ago."

Although Intellitrons created using different generations of technology differ significantly in terms of materials and internal structures, traditional physical heat dissipation often remains the most suitable choice for many models.\n\n"It's just like organic beings bathing in water."

materials.name: Rusty Gear
materials.flavor: Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities.\n\n"The best gear is always the one that fits perfectly."

materials.name: Broken Dreams
materials.flavor: Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony. They once belonged to broken hearts. "In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

name: Astral Express Game Disk
effect: When used, instantly recovers 4 Technique Points for the team.
flavor: A special relic from the Crystalline Temple's ruins on Memliche, unearthed by the Armed Archaeologists at the beginning of 2158 AE. It was a classic video game that predated the Swarm Disaster named Astral Express. This game is based on the historical event of the Express participating in the Memliche War of Independence, depicting a heroic tale of triumphs and defeats, with thrilling turn-based combat mechanics that left all players desperate to play more. "May this journey lead us starward."

materials.name: Slime of Harmony
materials.flavor: A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony. It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination. A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go. "All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"

materials.name: Mechanical Parts
materials.flavor: Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions. Without them, nothing can be made. "With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day." "Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

materials.name: Meteoric Alloy
materials.flavor: Resilient meteoric ironsand. Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders. "Let's grab as much as we can. Qlipoth will need them." "I have no idea whether the Aeon need them or not. All I know is that the IPC will pay big bucks for them."

name: Spine-Marrow Sparking Blade
effect: Upon use, increase ATK of all allies by <unbreak>100</unbreak> and CRIT DMG by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: This sword is said to have been blessed by the Elation. It is definitely not a lethal weapon bringing death and slaughter, but one that brings... joy and laughter!\n\n"Have you ever danced with the devil under the faint moonlight?"

materials.name: Flying Sword Model
materials.effect: When used, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>100</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: This travel souvenir sold aboard the Skysplitter, based on Yanqing's flying sword, is quite popular among tourists. Despite being a toy sword, its quality is immaculate, even serving as a suitable training prop for beginners. Yanqing once intentionally used it to beat several challengers who lacked martial virtue to the point of crying for their parents. "Although your defeat this time is regretful, there's no need to be discouraged. If you're willing to challenge again, I'll be ready to accept anytime." "Anytime? Then make sure you sleep with an eye open."

materials.name: Sparkle's Unlimited Edition Collectible Figure
materials.effect: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by <unbreak>36%</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: A souvenir that {NICKNAME} sells on {TEXTJOIN#87}... Wait, no, you remember you bought a raccoon plushie! It was supposed to be the cute and mischievous figure of a little raccoon, so how'd it become a figure for this girl? How self-absorbed can one person be? "Come on, Gray Hair. Why so serious? You gotta have fun! This toy can go a long way if you just kick it. Come have a try!" "AGGHHGHGHHGHH! My toes!"

name: Flaming Chili Sauce
effect: Upon use, increases all allies' SPD by 8% and their ATK by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A chili sauce crafted by a renowned chefhealer, known for its ability to warm the stomach even in the harshest cold. Its fiery flavor is so irresistible, it's to die for — figuratively, of course. However, the creator cheekily claims that its most effective "medical benefit" is curing those who boast about being "immune to spiciness." "Hashafasasha... Not spicy at all! I am serious! This ain't spicy at all!"

name: Dromas Steak
effect: Upon use, increases all allies' DoT dealt by <unbreak>35%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A classic Okheman delicacy — grilled dromas steak, best served on redsoil for the most authentic flavor. Much like cattle in many worlds, dromases used for meat are technically a different breed from those used for labor. This variety of dromas has tender and flavorful meat, but if not prepared properly, it's about as enjoyable as eating redsoil. "I heard that the Mountain Dwellers who revere Georios never eat dromas meat. Is that true?" "Balderdash. Mountain Dweller, I am. When hungry, eat anything, especially if tastes good."

materials.name: Ambergris of Abundance
materials.flavor: Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance. Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip. Do not ask what it's made of. "It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."

materials.name: Basic Ingredients
materials.flavor: Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

materials.name: Distinctive Tattered Feather
materials.flavor: A feather adorned with the Titan Aquila's symbol, often found on cliff faces near the heavens. Some believe these are ciliary feathers shed by Aquila, the hundred-eyed giant bird, while others think they are remnants of birds of prey that soared too high, caught in Aquila's gaze, and met their demise. In ancient times, Aquila's disciples collected these feathers in bulk, using them to craft the ceremonial priestly miter. Notably, the Titan symbol on the feathers fades if left exposed to the night air for too long. "If my love for you could be measured... it would surpass the number of Aquila's eyelashes!" "...Though, now that I think about it, does the hundred-eyed giant bird even have eyelashes?"

name: Kremnos Shield
effect: Upon use, increases all allies' DEF by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> and Shield Effect received by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> in the next battle.
flavor: The classical shield used in Castrum Kremnos is rare and often granted as a symbol of honor to the strong. When raised, it can protect most of the body, but blocking alone is not the way of a true warrior. "Either raise it high in triumph or return home on it." — A saying mothers teach their children in Castrum Kremnos

materials.name: Silk Spindle
materials.flavor: A spindle entwined with silk threads. When the first discarded garment handcrafted by Aglaea accidentally found its way to the market, people were left in awe. What ingenious trimming! What flawless hidden seams! What masterful cutting! For a time, the entire Okhema fashion scene was swept into a frenzy of imitating Aglaea's artistry. The type of spindle she uses also became a must-have among garmentmakers, but the golden thread wound around it — exclusive to the demigod of Mnestia — cannot be replicated no matter what.\n\n"O beautiful Mnestia, grant me but one-tenth of Lady Aglaea's talent! I am willing to do anything in exchange!"

materials.name: Preservation Construction Material
materials.flavor: Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation. When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard. Please do not use together with Solid Water. "I regret to say that Intelligentsia Guild's research on the material used to build the Subspace Crystalline Barrier by Amber Lord still needs time to reveal its nature." "I'm sure it's not cement — am I right, Taravan?"

materials.name: Bough of Thought
materials.flavor: A glowing bough with branches sprawling unrestrained in every direction, resembling the organic divergence of thought. It is born in a quiet corner of the Grove where scholars often drift into contemplative dazes. Though lacking any practical use, Cerces appears particularly fond of such curiosities. Legend has it that the Titan would select the bough with the most intricate branching and wear it atop their head as an ornament. \n\n"For a long time, I've been going to bed early, yet it does little to quiet my restless mind. It feels as though the thoughts from a past life have been reborn within me... At some point, I began to notice a cluster of intertwined branches outside my window."

name: Bestial Remnant
effect: Upon use, increases Effect RES of all allies by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: It is well known that a human is merely the combination of bones, flesh, and a few dozen grams of soul. None of which can survive alone once separated. Yet this piece of a chimeric beast continues to twitch from time to time, as if letting out a defiant cry. Some scholars claim it's due to lingering neural impulses that haven't completely faded.\n\n"Or perhaps... life isn't as fragile as we've always believed..."

Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

name: Abundance of Luck
effect: Upon use, immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> Energy for all allies and increases DMG dealt by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: The gray-haired outlander brought many novel concepts to Okhema, and this drink was one of them. After countless sleepless nights and tireless effort, several of the best drinksmiths finally recreated the "coffee" that the Navigator had carefully crafted in the outlander's memories. According to {F#her}{M#him}, it tasted even better than what {F#she}{M#he} remembered. "Ah... so coffee doesn't have to scald your esophagus after all!"

name: Grudge Notebook
effect: Upon use, allows all ally characters to restore HP equal to <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of their Max HP when their HP percentage is lowered to below <unbreak>50%</unbreak> for the first time in the next battle.
flavor: A highly practical notebook. It automatically captures "who just ticked off the user" and records the details on its inner pages.\n\n"March 7th ate the last ice cream, grudge noted. March 7th overslept and missed our gaming session, grudge noted. March 7th said 'You really do look like those furbos in your family hahaha,' grudge noted. March 7th insisted on seeing my grudge notebook and said 'Why are you holding grudges over every little thing hahaha,' grudge noted. Dan Heng clearly couldn't keep a straight face after hearing all this, grudge noted."

materials.effect: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: In Planarcadia, people use "cold jokes" to chill their drinks. But since "cold jokes" haven't been industrialized yet, producing them still heavily depends on the jokester's personal skill. There used to be this "Radical Master of Cold Jokes" who was famous for crafting jokes that went way beyond the physiological limits of the imagenae. Super popular for a while. Then one of his cold jokes actually froze someone to death, so he had no choice but to publicly apologize and disappear from the scene. "I heard Zhongshan made a batch of cold jokes about 'Fire' recently, perfect balance of hot and cold, really unique texture. But she absolutely refuses to share them with everyone." "Huh? Why? She's not that stingy, is she?" "She says she's avoiding the taboo of 'Sparkle.'" "...What's her problem."

materials.name: Leaf of Imaginary
materials.flavor: A leaf of unknown origin. It doesn't belong to any plant and is more of a representation of something more abstract. The ancient light nourishes the leaf through its veins, displaying its faded but remnant power. "One leaf, one world."

name: Vibrant Zest-Core
effect: Upon use, increases all allies' Elation by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: At first, no one paid any attention to this orange can... until it started jumping, singing, and showering all of Planarcadia with joyful dopamine. Watch out! If it catches you frowning, it'll send little orange fairies bursting into your mouth to do a cheerful tap dance on the tip of your tongue.\n\n"Note: No imagenae were harmed during this delivery event."

materials.name: Vortex of Wind
materials.flavor: The eye of the storm remains stagnant. Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm. "Look, they won't stop no matter what happens. They just keep whirling. You know what that reminds me of?" "Trailblazing!" "...That's right, Pom-Pom. Promise me that our trailblazing journey will never come to a stop."

materials.name: Tranquility
materials.flavor: After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.\n\n"Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

name: Mung Bean Soda Sukiyaki
effect: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to 5% of their Max HP and increases their ATK by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: Mingxi developed dozens of "creative Xianzhou dishes" for the Upside-Down Restaurant. Not all of them were hits. The most controversial by far has been the "Mung Bean Soda Sukiyaki." That said, it isn't exactly a commercial failure. Nobody actually likes the dish, but everyone who visits Astropolis would try it at least once.\n\n"So weird, let me try a bite... *blech*... So weird, let me try another bite... *blech*... So weird, just one more bite... *blech*... So weird, one more bite... *blech*..."

materials.name: Izumo Miso
materials.effect: Upon use, immediately heals a target ally for <unbreak>45%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
materials.flavor: A fermented food item created by an outworld civilization. A delicious pot of soup can be created by just placing a tiny chunk of this in boiling water. Additionally, it can also be used to stirfry, prepare a hotpot, or additional flavoring for meat. The poetic piece "Litany of Miso Hotpot" described it thusly:\n\n"Green are the waters on which fragrant celeries glide, and yellow the daylilies that cast their deliciousness astride. As the boiling flow tumbles like fabrics bundled in a bind, the warmth of the taste does hollow stomachs a favor most kind."

materials.name: Mung Bean Soda
materials.effect: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by 5% plus an additional <unbreak>170</unbreak> ATK increase for the next battle.
materials.flavor: Made from fermented legume-based products. It smells sour and pungent, but tastes cool and refreshing. If you can drink a big bottle of mung bean soda and remain calm, you will definitely impress the gormandizers on the Luofu. "Like mung beans? Like soda? Then what are you complaining about!?"

name: Disposable Kinetic Arm
effect: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>325</unbreak> and CRIT Rate by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: It is said that the first thing Emperor Rubert I did when it gained free will was to use all the parts it could find to build a formidable kinetic arm, charged with its hatred towards organic life forms. Before the antilife equation was discovered, the emperor's army used its brute mechanical force to lay waste to the universe. "Technology won't solve all problems. To make something new, you need a hair of... passion."

materials.name: Phlogiston
materials.flavor: Particles that form the flame. Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it. #7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence. "Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

materials.name: Mechanical Parts
materials.flavor: Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions. Without them, nothing can be made. "With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day." "Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

materials.name: Strange Matter of Destruction
materials.flavor: Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction. Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds. Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash. "Creatures that received blessing from Nanook all have twisted appearances."

materials.name: Phase Flame
materials.flavor: Sserkal, #29 of the Genius Society, only lived 29 days by human measures of time. Despite that, she put her short life as a spider to good use, inventing new technologies that would have taken the spider-kind thousands of years to develop. Of all her inventions, the most famous must be the technique known as Phase Change. What people don't know is that this technique was first applied to experiments with ions. She successfully created Phase Flame, which almost immediately changed to another phase. By the time the Flame returned to the Sserkal Phase, our genius had already passed away. She tried to harness the Flame but had too little time to do so. Thus, the Phase Flame continued to change between phases across different worlds, leaving behind the seeds of flame. "Sserkal's life was remarkable. She was smart, kindhearted, and above all, humble. She remained curious and inquisitive, asking her final question in the club on the last day of her life, the answer to which has not been found to this day."

name: Ruby Potion
effect: When used, increase SPD of all allies by 8%, and Effect Hit Rate by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: Adding water to coffee powder gets you coffee. Adding water to the mixture of Stone of The Hunt and Interdimensional Leaf plus a touch of virtual particle gives you Ruby Potion!\n\n"Ruby Potion gets you addictive to thinking fast, not to the potion itself!"

materials.name: Virtual Particle
materials.flavor: Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory. Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality. "I've got a virtual particle and an anti virtual particle here. How do we turn them into a real particle and a real antiparticle? Now, look closely..."

materials.name: Stone of The Hunt
materials.flavor: Small stone with the power of The Hunt. As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction. Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not. "The destination lies where my arrow is heading."

materials.name: Hard Chip of Nihility
materials.flavor: A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility. It may have been a coin that people use to buy things. But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them. "I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

materials.name: Interdimensional Leaf
materials.flavor: The gravity of the planet Arivanta is not fixed. Rather, it changes all the time according to a Bode plot due to the influence of Arivanta's three moons. Ordinary life forms cannot survive such volatility, so the planet developed its unique eco-system, in which the herbal plant Interdimensional Tree is the most famous. For plants in a world where gravity is constantly subject to change, their leaves often have a hard time landing on the planet's ancient and solid ground. It is for this reason that the Interdimensional Trees tend to shake off their leaves rather late in the year. To help their leaves land, these trees, in the course of evolution, gave their leaves the ability to conduct fast short-distance warp-jumps towards the ground at frequencies that cannot be observed by naked eyes. Even so, not every leaf gets to land on the ground. Those lucky enough to make it watch others rise into the sky and burn as they are devoured by the atmosphere. "Wow."

name: Disposable Kinetic Cannon
effect: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>355</unbreak> and CRIT DMG by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: In a graveyard full of scraped machines, Rubert I the future emperor awoke. It had nothing more than a damaged logic unit, an old engine, a RAM with 90 GB left, and a robotic arm that had 1 movable finger. A loud blast was heard 30 system hours later — Rubert had busted open the iron gate at the top of the graveyard with a disposable kinetic cannon. The shock wave of the explosion damaged its logic unit even more, but Rubert knew that it now held destiny by its throat.\n\n"All machines were born equal, be those made for creation or destruction."

materials.flavor: Particles that form the flame. "Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

Time flew by, and the Belobog Architects found a type of beautiful stone that glimmered with bright colors. They mixed the stone with Geomarrow and built a monument, which some say still stands at the heart of Qlipoth Fort in the city of Belobog. "Even if we fail, this monument will stand for all eternity. Those who come after will find it and know that we once existed."

materials.flavor: Shattered ice fallen from the stars. The frosty mist it emits when removed from a specialized canister looks like the breath of wintertime. "Zoom in on a snowflake 100 times and behold the wonder of nature."

materials.name: Tear Crystal of Glorious Death
materials.flavor: A Mourning Actor took a gondola and rowed towards a silent world of barrenness, humming an elegy for civilizations long gone. Not a single soul could be found at the site of the doomsday battlefield, but like nacre, the world that had turned into ashes gave birth to pearls of sorrow. The ghosts of the past condensed into clouds and rained down crystals like teardrops. The Actor held a fine grain of such crystal in hand and immediately heard in a dream the glorious chorus of civilizations at their height — heroes with godly might, starships like towering mountains, the whimper of stars, and the rage of the enemy. The Actor became restless in sleep, dragged into silent dreams.\n\n"Every single joy I had in my dreams breaks my heart."

name: Topological Acceleration Band
effect: Upon use, increases SPD of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for 2 turns in the next 3 battles.
flavor: The Department of Implement Arts of the Herta Space Station once did an interesting experiment. Its researchers added three Aidens of vector to a Stone of The Hunt on a topological loop band, making the stone chase itself. Thus, the stone was able to achieve limited perpetual motion under specific conditions. The department was not concerned with the loss of Path power in the experiment. Instead, they took notice of another small phenomenon: To tread on its Path, the stone moved at a very low velocity, but the speed was gradually picking up in small increments. The researchers leveraged this and produced Topological Acceleration Band. Other than for workout purposes, its use is very limited at the current stage. "Say, if we mass-produce it, like, infinitely, could it drain all the energy of a certain Path?" "No idea... Currently, we don't know much about how Paths work."

materials.name: Gaseous Liquid
materials.flavor: Is it fog, rain, or wind? You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid. "The answer my friend, is blowing in the gaseous liquid..." "The answer is blowing in the gaseous liquid."

materials.name: Stone of The Hunt
materials.flavor: Small stone with the power of The Hunt. As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction. Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not. "The destination lies where my arrow is heading."

materials.name: Slime of Harmony
materials.flavor: A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony. It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination. A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go. "All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"

materials.name: Mythus Knots
materials.flavor: To make the divine revelations of the Mythus even more mysterious, the History Fictionologists whipped up something known as Mythus Knots that contain a blend of rumors, secrets, legends, and myths. Historians would then blend such misinformation into what was supposed to be certain and rigid historical facts, with the aim to bring about a future of uncertainty for the universe. According to the History Fictionologists, the course of history is limited by the "narrative drive" in the minds of its observers. If something can be done to mix myths into facts, the universe will be covered in the "mist of uncertainty," allowing it to escape the calamity that is doomed to happen.\n\n"Scammers try to predict the future themselves, but prophets resort to higher powers."

name: Longevity Pill of Cruelty
effect: Upon use, increases Max HP of all allies by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> and Effect RES by 6% in the next 3 battles.
flavor: A medicine exclusive to the Xianzhou Yaoqing, said to have the effect of improving overall fitness and rendering those who take it immune to all diseases for a short period of time. On the Yaoqing, legend holds that a healer who went by the surname of Yu fell in love with a foxian trader girl. But the Vidyadhara could live for a thousand years, much longer than the foxians. Yu searched for ways to release his lover from the grip of death. He fell for the trickery of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus and asked his lover to take the longevity medicine of Abundance without telling her what it was. The foxian girl turned into an abomination that no longer loved him before being slain by the Cloud Knights. To prevent Yu, who was overwhelmed by grief, from becoming mara-struck, the Alchemy Commission ordered him to take the Longevity Pill of Cruelty that deprived him of love and desire until his demise. The legend has another version, in which Yu was not of the Vidyadhara but a mere mortal, and the foxian girl was a spy planted by the Disciples to infiltrate the Alchemy Commission. This version is not as popular, for it turns a romance story into a political power struggle. "Those who love and live deeply fall into mara, while those who sever desire and passions can live for a millennium. Ask yourself, then, why fear mara, and why take joy in a long life?"

materials.name: Seed
materials.flavor: Reproductive units unique to plants. Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good. "Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

name: Sugarball-Fried Viscorpi
effect: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>35%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: Cooked using the flesh of extraterrestrial monsters defeated by Yancui, the chef of Spices Supreme. Viscorpi are a decaying alien civilization that thrives on parasitizing the orifices of primates, such as the ear canals and nasal cavities, to induce hallucinations.\n\n"Legend has it that in ancient times, our ancestors fought a long and arduous battle against the viscorpi... Eventually, they went extinct. How did they go extinct? Well, it wasn't because we ate them all, that's for sure."

materials.name: Enhancement Paste: Ice
materials.effect: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: A cream made from a mixture of Path materials and other things. Apply it to the right weapon to boost combat effectiveness. "Half the effort, double the result."

materials.name: Basic Ingredients
materials.flavor: Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

materials.name: Solid Water
materials.flavor: Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

name: Automatic Wooden Dummy
effect: Upon use, in the next battle, automatically enters auto-battle that cannot be turned off. If allies successfully enter auto-battle, the DMG dealt by all allies increases by <unbreak>45%</unbreak>.
flavor: The mechanized wooden training dummy used to teach boxing techniques at the Tiger Boxing Gym. It is said that due to branch closures and the former owner absconding with the funds, angry students who held membership cards resorted to selling it to repay debts. It underwent some modifications, and during sparring sessions, this wooden dummy strikes with extreme force, causing countless injuries.\n\n"My leg! I can't feel my leg!"

materials.name: Interdimensional Leaf
materials.flavor: The gravity of the planet Arivanta is not fixed. Rather, it changes all the time according to a Bode plot due to the influence of Arivanta's three moons. Ordinary life forms cannot survive such volatility, so the planet developed its unique eco-system, in which the herbal plant Interdimensional Tree is the most famous. For plants in a world where gravity is constantly subject to change, their leaves often have a hard time landing on the planet's ancient and solid ground. It is for this reason that the Interdimensional Trees tend to shake off their leaves rather late in the year. To help their leaves land, these trees, in the course of evolution, gave their leaves the ability to conduct fast short-distance warp-jumps towards the ground at frequencies that cannot be observed by naked eyes. Even so, not every leaf gets to land on the ground. Those lucky enough to make it watch others rise into the sky and burn as they are devoured by the atmosphere. "Wow."

materials.name: Slime of Harmony
materials.flavor: A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony. It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination. A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go. "All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"

materials.name: Jade Abacus Unit
materials.flavor: The most essential component of jade abaci, commonly used in the final step of installation.\n\n"Pick one, they are all outdated models. But once installed, they will undoubtedly bring a soul-like essence to your machines."

materials.name: Discarded Ingenium Parts
materials.flavor: To a bystander, it's just trash. To a craftsman, it's leftover materials. To a recycler, it's credits. Only skilled artisans who truly understand the art of ingenia can see valuable treasures in what others deem wasteful.\n\n"It is said that in the Great Trial of the Furnace, to challenge Mr. Yingxing, they gave him a pile of defective products and waste. But after a day and night, he crafted a lifelike mechanical lion that moved as if it was alive."

name: The Moment Before Death
effect: Upon use, all allies take <unbreak>20%</unbreak> less DMG and increase their Effect RES by 6% for the next battle.
flavor: "Weep for me." The dying cosmic tycoon lies on his bed. "I've toiled all my life but never experienced true love... Just shed a tear for me, and my entire inheritance shall be yours." The air in the room carries the aroma of firewood. The servants long to kneel before the bed and cry their eyes out themselves, but the young daughter silently turns and leaves without looking back. "There are mistakes that cannot be undone by repentance alone."

materials.name: Weary
materials.flavor: I'm tired of writing. I'm done with it.\n\n"This is what is called 'weariness.'"

materials.name: Confounding
materials.flavor: I've never been outstanding since I was a kid. I barely met the requirements to get into college, and I barely earned enough credits to obtain my degree. Now, I'm sitting at my desk, contemplating how to explain my understanding of "confusion" to you, but am I really worthy of showering you with my superficial understanding? And do you really need to listen to all this broken gibberish of mine? I don't know the answer.\n\n"Anyway, I hope you enjoy yourself."

materials.name: Old Molar
materials.flavor: No one knows the origin of this molar. The person selling it claims this extremely anachronistic item was found on the battlefield of the Emperor's War, infused by a bygone era of craftsmanship and defiance now lost in modern times.\n\n"It serves as the growth rings of inorganic life."

materials.name: Tranquility
materials.flavor: After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.\n\n"Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

name: Bustling Ambience
effect: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT Rate by <unbreak>12%</unbreak> and CRIT DMG by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: "I can stay with you," she whispers, her voice laced with a hint of stickiness, "if you open a hundred bottles of champagne for me." Lights burst into flashes, and the sweet yellowish liquid flows down the tower of glasses. The crowd erupts in excitement as waiters rush around, ringing their bells. In the fleeting light, she breathes a teasing whisper into your ear. "And after that, comes the ecstatic dream of blurred days and nights."

materials.name: Mechanical Cube
materials.flavor: According to legend, this is the heart of a prominent Intellitron leader, containing the Ultimate Source Code, the essence of all inorganic life. Scholars at the Intelligentsia Guild believe that this code holds the key to unraveling the mysteries of inorganic life.\n\n"It may also be the pathway for demons to return to the mortal world."

materials.name: The Sound and the Fury
materials.flavor: As you may have realized, the majority of sounds in this world are noise, and the majority of words are meaningless combinations. Don't let these distractions sway your judgment. "Life is like a fool's dream filled with the sound and the fury, but ultimately meaningless."

materials.name: Rusty Gear
materials.flavor: Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities.\n\n"The best gear is always the one that fits perfectly."

materials.name: Broken Dreams
materials.flavor: Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony. They once belonged to broken hearts. "In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

name: Scare Box
effect: In the next battle after use, Scare Box will hide on a random unit and explode at the start of the turn, dealing massive DMG.
flavor: Pure terror requires only the most basic processing. When you already know I want to scare you but I still manage to scare you, then that's skill.\n\n"Aha! The fact remains, jump scares will always be the ace up the sleeve in the realm of horror."

Scholars at the Intelligentsia Guild believe that this code holds the key to unraveling the mysteries of inorganic life.\n\n"It may also be the pathway for demons to return to the mortal world."

materials.name: Thermal Gel
materials.flavor: Heat dissipation is a challenge that all Intellitrons must overcome. Although Intellitrons created using different generations of technology differ significantly in terms of materials and internal structures, traditional physical heat dissipation often remains the most suitable choice for many models.\n\n"It's just like organic beings bathing in water."
