name: Take Your Life <unbreak>3000</unbreak>
effect: Upon use, immediately regenerate <unbreak>30%</unbreak> Energy for all allies. In the next battle, increase ATK by <unbreak>100</unbreak> and DMG dealt by <unbreak>35%</unbreak>. Upon entering battle, there's a <unbreak>10%</unbreak> base chance to enter the Strong Reverberation state, lasting for 1 turn.
flavor: It's widely known that putting powerful things together makes them even more powerful. Like Granny Chen's Tofu, SoulGlad, and Izumo Miso — each delicious on its own. If you mix them together... um, maybe that example wasn't great, forget it.\n\n"These deadly weapons, each formidable on their own, are now gathered together. Are you afraid yet?"

materials.name: Flying Sword Model
materials.effect: When used, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>100</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: This travel souvenir sold aboard the Skysplitter, based on Yanqing's flying sword, is quite popular among tourists. Despite being a toy sword, its quality is immaculate, even serving as a suitable training prop for beginners. Yanqing once intentionally used it to beat several challengers who lacked martial virtue to the point of crying for their parents. "Although your defeat this time is regretful, there's no need to be discouraged. If you're willing to challenge again, I'll be ready to accept anytime." "Anytime? Then make sure you sleep with an eye open."

materials.name: Tranquil Duster
materials.effect: Upon use, the target ally immediately regenerates <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of their Energy.
materials.flavor: A wooden duster. Before the activation of important ingenia such as the Matrix of Prescience, craftsmen of the Artisanship Commission will always invite the most qualified masters to perform a warding ceremony with their golden rods, which are dipped in purified water and scattered around the place. It is said that these kinds of rituals decrease ingenia malfunctions by 62.33%. "Believe in science! the only purpose this serves is psychological comfort..." "No, you're not getting it! This is seriously different!"

materials.name: Self-Sufficer
materials.effect: When used, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>190</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: Item seized from the remnants of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, modifier unknown. After extending it to the hard-to-reach places on one's back, the branches will begin scratching automatically with moderate force and accurate acupuncture point recognition.\n\n"This familiar feeling reminds me of every time in the past when my back would itch, and my younger brother would help me scratch it. Unfortunately, he later joined the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus..."

materials.name: Hypnotic Hammer
materials.effect: Upon use, decreases DMG taken by all allies by <unbreak>18%</unbreak> for the next battle. When entering battle, there is a <unbreak>10%</unbreak> base chance to be afflicted with Strong Reverberation, lasting for 1 turn.
materials.flavor: A hypnotic medicine from the outworld civilization of Orch Republic that sells extremely well over there. All it takes is a single slam of the hammer for the deepest slumber to arrive.\n\n"It's up to the product to make you fall asleep, but it's up to an individual's luck to wake back up again."

name: Veil Bundle
effect: Upon use, one of the following effects will be randomly applied to all allies in the next battle: SPD increases by <unbreak>20%</unbreak>; Break Effect increases by <unbreak>60%</unbreak>; Effect Hit Rate increases by <unbreak>60%</unbreak>.
flavor: Caravans in Amphoreus often sell these mysterious, loosely twine-wrapped bundles. They could be unwanted trash or gifts from the Titans to mortals, with unpredictable surprises upon opening. It's said that this is a tradition among Oronyx's followers, who view such enigmatic goods as a ritual of offering pros and cons to fate, leaving the power of determining value to the Evernight Veil's capriciousness.\n\n"Heh heh heh, in truth, this idea was invented by old Zagreus, and the faithful who buy it aren't motivated by piety at all — they just love the thrill of the gamble!"

materials.name: Fresh Seed of Dawn
materials.flavor: Legend has it that Amphoreus once hosted a beauty pageant where several renowned beauties each plucked a fruit from the golden apple tree. Mnestia declared that the contestant who returned the following year with their golden apple still intact would be deemed the most beautiful. When the year passed, none of the contestants succeeded in the trial — even the finest golden apples had rotted, just as even the most radiant faces inevitably fade with time. But in the third year, an ordinary-looking peasant girl returned, not with an apple, but with a new seedling. She explained that she had been deeply saddened by the golden apple's decay and had carefully gathered the seeds from the rotting fruit, planting them to nurture a new tree. Moved by her actions, Georios appeared and urged Mnestia to crown the peasant girl as the most beautiful contestant. Mnestia, however, was reluctant, unable to see any beauty in the girl. At that moment, Georios called upon Oronyx to cover Mnestia's eyes with the veil of night. The instant Mnestia lost their sight, they perceived the brilliance of the peasant girl's heart and joyfully awarded her the title. "Agy, doesn't this legend sound like your story?" "Heh... a beautiful tale, indeed."

materials.name: Silk Spindle
materials.flavor: A spindle entwined with silk threads. When the first discarded garment handcrafted by Aglaea accidentally found its way to the market, people were left in awe. What ingenious trimming! What flawless hidden seams! What masterful cutting! For a time, the entire Okhema fashion scene was swept into a frenzy of imitating Aglaea's artistry. The type of spindle she uses also became a must-have among garmentmakers, but the golden thread wound around it — exclusive to the demigod of Mnestia — cannot be replicated no matter what.\n\n"O beautiful Mnestia, grant me but one-tenth of Lady Aglaea's talent! I am willing to do anything in exchange!"

materials.name: Bough of Thought
materials.flavor: A glowing bough with branches sprawling unrestrained in every direction, resembling the organic divergence of thought. It is born in a quiet corner of the Grove where scholars often drift into contemplative dazes. Though lacking any practical use, Cerces appears particularly fond of such curiosities. Legend has it that the Titan would select the bough with the most intricate branching and wear it atop their head as an ornament. \n\n"For a long time, I've been going to bed early, yet it does little to quiet my restless mind. It feels as though the thoughts from a past life have been reborn within me... At some point, I began to notice a cluster of intertwined branches outside my window."

materials.name: Distinctive Tattered Feather
materials.flavor: A feather adorned with the Titan Aquila's symbol, often found on cliff faces near the heavens. Some believe these are ciliary feathers shed by Aquila, the hundred-eyed giant bird, while others think they are remnants of birds of prey that soared too high, caught in Aquila's gaze, and met their demise. In ancient times, Aquila's disciples collected these feathers in bulk, using them to craft the ceremonial priestly miter. Notably, the Titan symbol on the feathers fades if left exposed to the night air for too long. "If my love for you could be measured... it would surpass the number of Aquila's eyelashes!" "...Though, now that I think about it, does the hundred-eyed giant bird even have eyelashes?"

name: Monarch's Maneuver
effect: Upon use, increases all allies' SPD by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> and their ATK by <unbreak>10%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A new toy made of gemstones. Players take turns as opposing sides, black and white, simulating a battlefield where victory is claimed by capturing the enemy's king. Yet in the distant Northern Lands, there exists a unique player, she always moves her king first, and wins time and time again.\n\n "Should the king not lead, how could the vassals be willing to follow?"

materials.name: Vortex of Wind
materials.flavor: The eye of the storm remains stagnant. Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm. "Look, they won't stop no matter what happens. They just keep whirling. You know what that reminds me of?" "Trailblazing!" "...That's right, Pom-Pom. Promise me that our trailblazing journey will never come to a stop."

materials.name: Metal
materials.flavor: A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean. Very useful, very handy. "I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."

name: Boneflute of Fish-Calling
effect: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>15%</unbreak> and DoT dealt by <unbreak>30%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: It is said that in the ancient coastal region of Styxia, fishermen would play a bone flute to attract schools of fish. Sometimes, sea sirens lurking among the reefs would also be drawn to the music, rising from the water to sing in duet with the fishermen. At times, the fishermen would gift the bone flute to the sea sirens, who in turn would offer their scales in return.\n\n "Humans and sea sirens forged a pact, promising a grand feast, yet the guest of honor was left trapped beneath the waves."

materials.flavor: A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility. It may have been a coin that people use to buy things. But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them. "I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

materials.name: Meteoric Alloy
materials.flavor: Resilient meteoric ironsand. Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders. "Let's grab as much as we can. Qlipoth will need them." "I have no idea whether the Aeon need them or not. All I know is that the IPC will pay big bucks for them."

materials.flavor: Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

name: Steel Coil
effect: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to <unbreak>40%</unbreak> of their Max HP, and increases their Elation by <unbreak>40%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: A 30-ton steel coil. Due to a certain childhood trauma of moderate significance, a retail industry tycoon decided to use a special method to remind the residents of Planarcadia to pay attention to workplace and daily safety. Now, you can buy this type of steel coil at any convenience store in Planarcadia. "That's not my rubber ducky. It's not that flat."

materials.name: Tear Crystal of Glorious Death
materials.flavor: A Mourning Actor took a gondola and rowed towards a silent world of barrenness, humming an elegy for civilizations long gone. Not a single soul could be found at the site of the doomsday battlefield, but like nacre, the world that had turned into ashes gave birth to pearls of sorrow. The ghosts of the past condensed into clouds and rained down crystals like teardrops. The Actor held a fine grain of such crystal in hand and immediately heard in a dream the glorious chorus of civilizations at their height — heroes with godly might, starships like towering mountains, the whimper of stars, and the rage of the enemy. The Actor became restless in sleep, dragged into silent dreams.\n\n"Every single joy I had in my dreams breaks my heart."

My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

materials.name: Cold Joke
materials.effect: Upon use, increases Ice DMG of all allies by <unbreak>16%</unbreak> for the next battle.
materials.flavor: In Planarcadia, people use "cold jokes" to chill their drinks. But since "cold jokes" haven't been industrialized yet, producing them still heavily depends on the jokester's personal skill. There used to be this "Radical Master of Cold Jokes" who was famous for crafting jokes that went way beyond the physiological limits of the imagenae. Super popular for a while. Then one of his cold jokes actually froze someone to death, so he had no choice but to publicly apologize and disappear from the scene. "I heard Zhongshan made a batch of cold jokes about 'Fire' recently, perfect balance of hot and cold, really unique texture. But she absolutely refuses to share them with everyone." "Huh? Why? She's not that stingy, is she?" "She says she's avoiding the taboo of 'Sparkle.'" "...What's her problem."

name: Amber Lord Jumps Over the Wall
effect: Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> and CRIT DMG by <unbreak>24%</unbreak> for the next battle.
flavor: Mingxi has developed dozens of "creative Xianzhou dishes" for the Upside-Down Restaurant, and "Amber Lord Jumps Over the Wall" has been the most successful of them all. It has already become the go-to dish representing "high-end dining" in Astropolis. Given enough time, it might just come to define the "Astropolis cuisine" entirely. "Hey boss, why is it called 'Amber Lord Jumps Over the Wall' and not 'Amber Lord Builds the Wall'?" "'Builds the Wall'? I'm afraid you'd break a tooth trying to chew through that."

materials.name: Preservation Construction Material
materials.flavor: Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation. When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard. Please do not use together with Solid Water. "I regret to say that Intelligentsia Guild's research on the material used to build the Subspace Crystalline Barrier by Amber Lord still needs time to reveal its nature." "I'm sure it's not cement — am I right, Taravan?"

materials.name: Protein Rice
materials.flavor: Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives. Smooth as egg white and full of protein. "Every grain costs sweat and blood."

materials.name: Solid Water
materials.flavor: Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

materials.name: Basic Ingredients
materials.flavor: Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"
